tools.name: get_integration_code
tools.description: The exact install command and code to add TraceTail browser fingerprinting (a stable visitor ID for each browser, without cookies) to a web app built with the given framework, with where each file goes. Works without an API key (keyless mode, no sign-up); pass the site's public API key to fill it in

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches TraceTail's documentation, pricing, comparison and blog for a topic (e.g. "next.js", "rate limits", "ad blockers", "GDPR", "server-side verification") and returns the matching sections with their URLs.

tools.name: read_docs_page
tools.description: Returns a page of the TraceTail site as Markdown: "/docs" (the full documentation), "/pricing", "/vs-fingerprintjs", "/" (overview) or a blog post.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: TraceTail's prices and limits (1,000 identification requests free every month, then $0.10 per 1,000), with the monthly cost at a given volume and the same volume on Fingerprint (FingerprintJS) for comparison.

tools.name: create_setup_link
tools.description: Gets TraceTail API keys for the person you work for: returns a link to give them, where they sign in with an emailed code and add a card or continue without a card, and a token. Then call check_setup_link with its id and token every few seconds: once they've finished, it returns an API key for each

tools.name: check_setup_link
tools.description: Where a setup link stands. The first check after the person finishes returns the API keys (and the server key, if requested); they are not shown again. While they're still on the page, check again every few seconds.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_integration_code" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, read_docs_page · Private data: get_integration_code, create_setup_link, check_setup_link · Public sink: read_docs_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, read_docs_page · Private data: get_integration_code, create_setup_link, check_setup_link · Public sink: read_docs_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
